ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from the instructor with specific attendance directives. A required seminar for all seniors writing Honor Theses in history, this course will meet throughout the year and will supplement individual students' meetings with their primary advisors. Provides an intellectually supportive environment in which students work together on common methodological problems, share the results of their research, and critique developing projects. Concurrent enrollment in HIST 493 required.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to History major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
